fields.Name: Sales: Stage Conversion and Dwell
fields.UserQuestion: How do deals move between stages, how long do they sit, and which stages get skipped?
fields.Description: Conversion and dwell at the TRANSITION grain (master plan §9.1, §9.3 measure 7). This is the one measure that cannot be answered from Deal at all: the current stage says where a deal is, only the append-only event log says where it has been. Skipped and backward moves fall out for free because rows key on the (From, To) pair rather than on adjacency.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: DealStageEvent. Date dimension: ChangedAt. Dwell comes from the stored DaysInPreviousStage stamp rather than being derived by joining each event to its predecessor — the importer preserves original ChangedAt values, so the stamps are the authority. AmountAtTransition is the DEPARTING value, so value-weighted conversion reflects what was at stake at that moment rather than what the deal is worth today.

fields.Name: CompanyID
fields.Description: Selling company. Omit for every company. Deal.CompanyID is server-stamped from the pipeline, so it is always present and never needs a fallback.

fields.Name: PipelineID
fields.Description: One pipeline. Omit for all pipelines.

fields.Name: PeriodStart
fields.Description: Inclusive start of the window. Omit for no lower bound.

fields.Name: PeriodEnd
fields.Description: Inclusive end of the window. Omit for no upper bound.
